Example fixes (preserving HTML tags and order):
- Change "et sundt sinn" to "et sunt sinn" everywhere.
- Change "edruelig spenne sinnets liv opp og øve dem" to "holde sinnet edru og trene det" or similar context-appropriate phrasing.
Apply these as direct text replacements in the translated HTML.
